name: Surge of Brilliance
oracle_text:
Paradox — Draw a card for each spell you've cast this turn from anywhere other than your hand.
Foretell {1}{U} (During your turn, you may pay {2} and exile this card from your hand face down. Cast it on a later turn for its foretell cost.)
blocked_sentences: Paradox — Draw a card for each spell you've cast this turn from anywhere other than your hand.

needs.what: a value counting the spells a player has cast this turn from a zone other than their hand (Paradox): `spells_cast_this_turn` with a cast-zone filter, e.g. {"player": "you", "not_from_zone": ["hand"]}, which needs the turn ledger's SPELL_CAST fold to record each cast's origin zone beside `spells_cast_ids`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `spells_cast_this_turn` counts either all casts or those whose printed face matches a filter (`_matches_printed`); the turn ledger records only the cast card id, not the zone it was cast from. Counting all spells would overcount every hand-cast spell, including Surge of Brilliance itself when cast from hand. Foretell {1}{U} itself is expressible via the card-level `foretell` key
